is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles mosquitoes, specifically An. gambiae complex and An. funestus group, as stated in the abstract and methods (page 1, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotype data for Vgsc L995F (kdr-West) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-East) in An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. (Table 10, page 11).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 10 on page 11 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for L1014F and L1014S in An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. by district.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Cuando Cubango province, Angola (page 4, 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical study conducting entomological surveillance and KAP surveys (page 1, 4).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for specific sites: Makua, Agostinho Neto, and Cuchi (page 4, 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted from November 2020 to March 2021 (page 5, 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific entomological survey conducted in 2020-2021 in Cuando Cubango province.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and site information, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterized Anopheles mosquito populations and the impact of an IRS campaign in Cuando Cubango, Angola. It identified An. funestus s.s. as the primary vector and reported kdr mutation frequencies (L1014F and L1014S) for An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. collected from field sites.
